title: UseMutateOptions
subtitle: Configuration options for the useMutate hook
description: Type definition for the optional configuration object passed as the second argument to useMutate. Contains callbacks for mutation lifecycle events and query invalidation settings.

rows.name: onSuccess
rows.description: Callback fired when the mutation succeeds. Receives the returned data and the arguments that were passed to mutate.

rows.name: onError
rows.description: Callback fired when the mutation fails. Receives the error and the arguments that were passed to mutate.

rows.name: onSettled
rows.description: Callback fired when the mutation completes, regardless of success or failure. Receives data (or undefined), error (or undefined), and args.

rows.name: queryKey
rows.description: Query key to invalidate after the mutation completes. Triggers a refetch of the associated query.

behavior.title: Type Parameters
behavior.description: Generic types are usually inferred from the mutation function

behavior.title: Callback Order
behavior.description: onSuccess/onError fires first, then onSettled always fires

dos: Use onSuccess for success-only side effects like notifications
Use onSettled for cleanup that should happen regardless of outcome
Use queryKey to keep related queries in sync after mutations
donts: Don't perform heavy operations in callbacks - they block the UI
Don't forget to handle errors if not using onError
